WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM filtered_store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM filtered_catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM filtered_web_sales
) AS combined_results
LIMIT 100
